reviews.comment: Dr. R is a great lecturer and is very available to answer any questions. There are weekly quizzes which is a little annoying but they are pretty easy. The exams are worth 80% which sucks, you can replace lowest midterms with the final. He posts a lot of practive for the exams, make sure to study for it and it'll be ok. He's pretty funny too.
Took this course during summer 1. He is super chill and cares about his students.

Very easy grader, and would make his quizzes/exams much easier than the review materials. He made lectures engaging and enjoyable even if the material was pretty confusing. He's very sweet and will make sure you succeed.

Dr. Ranabhat is amazing! He's very theory heavy but he explains the topics in a way that anyone can understand. There are weekly quizzes and the exams need a decent amount of studying, but lots of practice material is given.

Dr. R was a amazing clac 3 instructor. He always shows up to class with energy and the lectures were never boring. He made the hard concepts easy to grasp and explains in a easy so you can pick them up super quickly. He's my glorious king definitely recommend!

Dr. R is honestly a goated professor. I am not very good at math and despite all the studying I did my grades weren't the best, but he never discouraged me or the class. A very optimistic professor who does love what he teaches, however, the class in general is just hard. He helped bump up my grade which meant I could pass, overall good professor!
This man is amazing! Take the class with him. You will not regret it.

I loved Dr. Ranabhat! If you aren't a math person, he teaches the class as if you haven't learned any math in your life. He walks you through even the most basic steps, and he always answers his emails super timely. There are in class polls, so if you miss those you'll get some zeroes, but the class isn't hard if you do the practice exams.
Professor Ranabhat cares about his students and will do everything he can to help. Just go to class and engage and you should do very well in this class.
my glorious king

Great prof, just teaches in a way that does not work with me. Very theory heavy with few examples in class then homework is a step or two higher in difficulty. Good about partial credit on exams, provides a lot of resources, weekly quizzes. Pay attention the best you can in class and you can succeed!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's a nice guy, final exam wasn't too hard either. Make sure to study well in advance like at least 2 weeks out from each test. As long as u don't get a 50 on exam 1 and on the final like me haha

Honestly he is an amazing prof. He gives an extensive amount of optional practice prior to tests, there is no difficulty in preparing/finding materials. The tests are fairly easy if you study, but you do have to study a lot(6-10hrs per test).
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: His class wasn't that bad. There was a quiz every week, and 1 singular pop quiz that I accidentally missed. The tests I think were on the easier side based on what I heard from my friends.

Go to the lectures and take notes and make sure you can solve all of the homework problems on your own. I think that's always the best advice for math courses. You want to attend lecture anyway because he might give a surprise quiz.

Great lecturer and explains concepts in a way that's easy to understand. He gives reviews and previous exams, which are very helpful for exam prep. There are quizzes every week over the last week's content, but they're not hard since they're basically just homework problems with different numbers
Great professor who genuinely cares about students' success. Offers some flexibility with grading but still emphasizes understanding the material.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The class is ok. He is a good lecturer, but you can kind of get lost in the lecture. Halfway through the semester, he just stopped telling us when we had quizzes, and then he randomly started doing it again, which was annoying. The only really bad thing about this class is the TA. The TA is probably the worst TA you will ever have.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Really good lecturer and tells you what you need to know and what will just help with your intuition for the concepts. Gives past exams and posts his notes on canvas, but lectures are still helpful. Class is 80 percent tests but he still tries to help you out by dropping hw and quizzes and is helpful during office hours.
It's hard to understand this professor. He has an accent.

Dr. R is one of the best math teachers on campus, his lectures are clear and detailed enough that if you miss that day's lecture you would be able to learn the content without much issue. He is pretty lenient on grading. He is very funny and also very caring. The one bad thing is he doesn't teach higher level math which sucks as everybody wants him

He's a really nice and caring professor. Some exams were harder than others, but he did not write them. He works hard to make sure students are prepared for them and replaces the lowest exam with the final (if you do better on the final). He was also really flexible and easy to access outside of class. Quite a bit of homework, similar to 151 & 152.

Ranabhat's class was very straightforward. His lectures are good and cover all the material needed on exams. Quizzes are weekly, but are not hard at all if you do the homework. Mock exams are very reflective of the actual exam. As long as you do the mock exams and homework, the class is a free A and the quizzes are really easy.
Really good professor. Gives out his finished notes and tests are easy to study for and is very nice.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He goes fast in lectures and requires attendance using iclicker questions, but he is very enthusiastic and excited about calc 3. At one point I submitted one of his biweekly take home quizzes on canvas instead of gradescope like he asked and he uploaded it for me from canvas without penalizing me. He uploads all his finished notes on canvas.
Very helpful and nice person! He has an accent but it was easy to get used to and he was very easy to reach outside of class. He helped me out so much, would definitely take again!

Such a good professor! He was so helpful outside of class and responded to emails so fast. His lectures are really good and he gives many helpful resources to study outside of class. I definitely recommend taking this class!!

I really liked Dr. R and his class. He was chill, down to earth, lenient in grading, and funny w/o trying to be. His tests were not too difficult, but that might change depending on higher ups. He would say stuff like "what variable can we kill" or "number A" which was funny. Quizzes were similar to exams, and he gave us practice exams to study.

His grading is really lenient; he's super kind and helpful outside of class and just wants people to succeed. He also ran WIR and his WIR problems were more or less just like the exams that he gave. He rounded me up to an A when I was right on the border. GOAT

Min Ranabhat is a good professor for this course. I have other friends in other 251 classes, and it seems  that Ranabhat's tests seems a lot easier compared to theirs (might change tho). The course is difficult in general, so you will need to study. He hosts week in reviews every week and going to those got me A+'s on exams. Really good professor.

Great professor! Sometimes reads over notes, but they're detailed enough that it makes sense. He also likes to use Expo markers as visuals for concepts like planes, vectors, curves, etc, which I found very useful. He explains complex topics using words everyone can understand (slight accent, but understandable). Calc 3 is also just fun.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Ranabhat was a very good professor. He gave us take-home quizzes and made his exams very fair. The content of the class was hard, but he made sure we were all prepared for the exam. I really appreciated that he posted filled-in notes.

Dr. R was a good professor and would take him again. He would do iclicker randomly most weeks but he dropped one . The homework was long sometimes. I would say the take-home quizzes were harder than the exams. Attending or going over the week-in-review sessions before the test was helpful because he led them.

His lectures were very informative and his slides explain the theory and tons of problem similar to test and homework's. Quizzes weren't bad since they were take home and he does reviews for the exam and also links a ton of resources, hw can be long but Drops a ton of assignment towards the end and final replaces lowest test. Overall amazing

He is a very caring professor who clearly cares about the subject and his students. He teaches the material well and his exam are easier than other professors, although the first exam I thought was quite difficult. He does do poll everywhere questions on random days so you'll want to be in class for those.

Great professor who put in effort over the semester to teach everyone well. Cares about his students. Take this professor if you get the chance. Most of your grade is based off of tests, but posts plenty of study materials.

I would say Min is a good guy, but a mediocre professor. You can tell he's really passionate about the material, but he goes over the theory a little too much. He's very accessible, and is always willing to help. He does the WIRs, which is cool. Sometimes his test questions felt like math trivia. He likes wearing really tight shirts.

Professor Ranabhat is a great professor! He makes a great effort to help students understand the material; you can tell he really cares. Homework and take-home quizzes help prepare you for his exams. He is also good about responding to emails. I would highly recommend him to anyone taking 251.
Always willing to help and a great lecturer. Exams are fair and homework gives you an idea of what to expect. He always explained the conceptual parts, which I found helpful.

Show up to class, he is a great teacher and the content is difficult. He will cover a few topics then do a bunch of examples showcasing that method fro the rest of the class. The quiz and questions will always be very similar to these so pay attention and make sure you know how he did it. The test is similar to quiz questions generally.
He is a great lecturer! He has easier tests than the other profs, doesn't take pollevery where (attendance) very often but it is random. He is easy to understand and has good notes.

Very chill and knowledgeable professor who can answer any question you give him. He does have an accent but it is very easy to understand him during lecture. Does occasional polleverywhere to make sure you're in class but they're pretty easy. Would 100% take this course again.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is a great teacher that makes a hard class a little easier. He cares about your grade and is willing to work with you. Class is a bit difficult but he really tries to help. Attend week in reviews!

His class is the equivalent to a precalculus class. It's not too difficult and he is very lenient with his grade dropping and extra credit. He goes beyond to accommodate for your needs and is very helpful and explanatory with work. Wouldn't recommend anyone but him he's the best!

Super hard tests. Tests are weighted so heavily that you could get a mid B and your grade will fall. He was unhelpful when I'd go in to office hours and just expected people to understand what he was talking about. I went to every hands on grades up and every tutoring session offered and still made a B. Do what you will with that info.

Dr. R was the best professor I could ask for. He was super kind and cared about his students deeply. The lectures were easy to follow. Attendance is somewhat mandatory due to iClicker's but manageable. If something comes up and you can't make it to class, shoot him an email and he's reasonable, allowing you to make up assignments. 10/10

Not a bad professor just tests were difficult, he knows what hes talking about it is just hard to follow along sometimes. I personally wish I would've been able to take John Fisk because I went to his hands up grades up and he did amazing. Min isn't the worst prof just not the best....

He was really nice and funny. Has an accent but definitely understandable. The content isn't that hard for the most part but you do have to go to lecture to be able to fill in the notes. Also had to watch some additional super short and quick lecture videos to fill in what wasn't covered in class. Very minimal outside work besides studying.

this guy is so silly and fun! he is very smart and knows what he's talking about. he does have a thick accent but isn't hard to understand. it's not a hard class if you actually put in the work (practicing homework, asking for help, using the math center). he is a great teacher and really wants students to understand the material!! i recommend him!

Dr.R was a wonderful professor and you can tell he really cares about his students! He is super sweet and his lectures are well thought out & easy to understand. The class does have lots of homework but he was always happy to answer questions when needed. Attendance isn't mandatory but there are quizzes that happen somewhat randomly.

Dr. Min was such a great teacher to have my first semester. His lectures were very easy to follow and he explained the hard problems in the simplest ways. He was happy to answer any questions I had and made sure that I truly understood what I was confused on. He also made it very clear when he would have a quiz or group assignment in class.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr.R is really nice guy and he tries his best to make class fun! There are quite a bit of homework assignments, but they prepare you really well for the tests. He does do iclicker questions, so be sure to go to his lectures everytime.

Dr. R was a great professor he genuinely cared about his students and made sure to answer all confusing questions. He also lectures well and makes sure everything is understood. He does iclickers and attendance checks so you may need to attend often. He also assigns a good amount of homework which sometimes is time-consuming but helpful for tests.
He lectures pretty well. However, he was pretty rude when I went in for office hours.
He is so nice and a very good professor! He always understands our questions perfectly and answers them very well. I would definitely take him again!

Dr. R is a great professor! Strongly recommend; he likes his job and is very friendly. He explains things well and makes lectures enjoyable. There are iClickers often and quizzes or group assignments most Fridays, but this is the case for most Math 140 classes. He makes the course straightforward and sends plenty of reminders. Take his class!

Dr. Ranabhat is a genuine professor who enjoys his job. Math140 is basic algebra and he covers the content pretty well during lecture. He is a very caring professor and drops a couple of grades at the end of the semester. Attendance is mandatory because of random iClickers. I wish I had him for all my math classes. I strongly recommend to take him!

My grade being low is entirely my fault for not paying much attention in class, but I do think of him as a good professor. He does do random iclickers for attendance thats worth a small portion of grade but you should be attending class since he covers a lot in lectures. He is a nice guy tho and will remind you of due dates for all assignments.

I did well in the class because I had already learned all of the material from pre-calculus in high school. I think it would have been more challenging if I hadn't known everything, but he is nice. Never had any problems; he always ensures you're prepared for the week's work and due dates. His test always seemed easier compared to other teachers.
